invariants.rationale: The method requires a HoodieEngineContext and immediately uses it, so it is expected to not be null.
instantTime is a required parameter for the upsert action and should be non-null for valid upserts.
A non-null hoodieRecords list is necessary for any upsert operation to execute effectively.
result is the outcome of a new object creation and execute method, so it should be non-null barring errors.
Write statuses are a key part of the HoodieWriteMetadata and should be present in the result.
